description: Station de location de vélo is a dataset listed in Data64 open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by OpenStreetMap. Extraction de la plateforme OpenStreetMap pour obtenir les stations de locations de vélo sur le territoire des Pyrénées Atlantiques. tag = amenity: bicyclerental Il vous est posssible d'améliorer la donnée en allant l'enrichir directement sur la plateforme OpenStreetMap. Coverage: Pyrénées-Atlantiques. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are vélo, stationnement, location, vivre dans le 64. The portal shows 41 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-le64-fr-portal.
